analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 31.2, entering oversold territory, with 5 consecutive days of decline. MACD histogram is improving but remains negative. The 5-day low of $27.93 is below the 20-day low of $27.93, reinforcing the Lower High pattern. Current price of $28.17 is near the swing support of $28.04, making entry too early, but weak trend reversal signals warrant a wait-and-see approach.
